promises-and-async-await.label: Promises and async-await
promises-and-async-await.summary: Understand a Promise as a future result, use await inside async functions, and handle rejected work with try/catch.

try_promises_and_async_await_sketch0.title: Try it yourself: Await a saved preference
try_promises_and_async_await_sketch0.prompt: Now apply what you just learned in this task. Problem: A saved preference arrives later, so the page cannot display the value until the asynchronous operation finishes. Task: Inside `showPreference`, await `preferencePromise` and show the result in `#preference`. Expected result: the Preview displays the resolved preference after the Promise completes. Produce the result for await a saved preference so it reinforces Promises and async-await.
try_promises_and_async_await_sketch0.hint: Update the DOM after the awaited value exists.

help.concept: await sequences code that depends on a Promise result.
help.hint_2: Store the awaited value before updating the paragraph.

try_promises_and_async_await_sketch1.title: Try it yourself: Show a failed sync message
try_promises_and_async_await_sketch1.prompt: Now apply what you just learned in this task. Problem: A sync operation can fail, and leaving the interface unchanged would make the failure invisible to the user. Task: Await the rejected `syncPromise` inside `try`. In `catch`, change `#sync-status` to `"Sync failed"`. Expected result: the Preview shows a clear failure message when the Promise rejects. Produce the result for show a failed sync message so it reinforces Promises and async-await.
try_promises_and_async_await_sketch1.hint: Put normal async work in try and fallback UI in catch.

help.concept: try/catch provides separate success and failure paths around awaited work.
help.hint_2: Use catch to replace the UI with the failure message.
